title: 第740章 目标幽冥界第739章 逐出师门
content_zh:
天空之上。
看着这一幕。
观音看向文殊，语气平静：
“恭喜你，文殊。”
“你这一次的计划，终于成功了。”
听到观音的“祝贺”。
文殊神情平静，摇头道：
“这件事，还没有结束。”
听到文殊的回答。
观音眉头一皱：
“什么意思？”
文殊目光深邃，望向远方：
“这白骨精虽死，但其魂魄未散。”
“这件事若是传出去，有损佛门威严。”
“贫僧必须让她消散于三界之中！”
听到文殊的话。
观音摇头道：
“文殊，你现在确实是成魔了。”
听到观音的话。
文殊嘴角微微上扬:

“若大士说的是蚩尤那种魔。”
“贫僧不屑去当。”
“是魔是佛，应该由贫僧自己说了算。”
“魔也好，佛也罢。”
“能笑到最后，才是最终的胜利者。”
观音看得出来。
文殊的心态，早已发生了改变。
或许，以前的文殊便是如此。
只是这场西游量劫，放大了文殊的野心。
观音没有多说。
因为她看出来，文殊并没有骗自己。
在文殊心里，他这么做真是不为了自己。
他是在为整个佛门布局。
即使以大菩萨之尊，来做这些上不得台面的事情。
文殊也心甘情愿。
这这一刻，观音有些明白。
为何世尊当初会选择让文殊布局西游量劫了。
content_en:
Above the sky.
Watch this scene.
Guanyin looked at Manjusri and said calmly:
"Congratulations, Manjusri."
"Your plan this time finally succeeded."
Hear Guanyin's "congratulations."
Manjusri looked calm, shook his head and said:
"This matter is not over yet."
Hear Manjusri's answer.
Guanyin frowned:
"What do you mean?"
Manjusri looked into the distance with deep eyes:
"Although this white-bone spirit is dead, its soul remains."
"If this matter spreads, it will damage the dignity of Buddhism."
"The poor monk must let her dissipate into the three realms!"
Hear the words of Manjusri.
Guanyin shook her head and said:
"Manjusri, you have indeed become a demon now."
Hear the words of Guanyin.
The corners of Manjusri's mouth raised slightly:
"Master Ruo is talking about a demon like Chi You."
"A poor monk doesn't bother to take the job."
"It is up to the poor monk to decide whether he is a demon or a Buddha."
"Whether it's a devil or a Buddha."
"The one who laughs to the end is the ultimate winner."
Guanyin can tell.
Manjusri's mentality has already changed.
Perhaps, this was the case with Manjusri in the past.
It's just that this journey to the west has magnified Manjusri's ambitions.
Guanyin didn't say much.
Because she could see that Manjusri did not lie to herself.
In Manjusri's heart, he really didn't do this for himself.
He is planning for the entire Buddhism.
Even if you have the dignity of a great Bodhisattva, you can do these unworthy things.
Manjusri was also willing.
At this moment, Guanyin understood something.
Why did the World-Honored One choose to let Manjusri plan the journey to the west to measure calamity?
